intro: Mornings begin better when everything has its place. With Zyne’s tall mirror and drawers for storage, you step into your day unhurried, surrounded by the calm tone of oak that steadies your mood.

features.title: A station that simplifies mornings
features.text: Drawers for makeup, grooming tools, or accessories keep your daily routine smooth, so you step out ready without stress.

features.title: Mirror that brightens and expands
features.text: The tall mirror reflects more light and space, adding depth to smaller rooms and making dressing feel effortless.

features.title: Timeless style in oak
features.text: Minimalist form paired with Sonoma Oak brown creates a dresser that blends across décor styles while keeping its warm personality.

features.title: Made to endure daily rituals
features.text: Crafted from 15 mm particle board (EN312, E2 grade) with a 4 mm mirror, designed for reliability through repeated use.

features.title: Assembly that moves with you
features.text: Arrives flat-packed and easy to put together, so moving or reconfiguring your setup never feels like a hassle.

name: Zyne Engineered Wood Dressing Table
